title: Rhythm Timing

beatIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between target beats; canonical alias takes precedence over spawnIntervalMs.

perfectWindowMs.description: Half-window ±ms around beat target. Perfect awards 10; clamped to goodWindowMs.

goodWindowMs.description: Half-window ±ms. Good awards 5. Clamped below half the beat interval to avoid overlap.

targetProgress.description: Progress AND requiredBestCombo must both be satisfied.

requiredBestCombo.description: Best continuous successful-hit streak needed in addition to progress. Zero disables the requirement.

durationSec.description: Active-play deadline; pause does not consume time.

damageOnMiss.description: Damage once per early or expired beat. Zero supports no-damage practice.

skipBoss.description: True selects judged rhythm. Explicit false selects legacy reaction/Boss compatibility mode, NOT covered by this card acceptance.

rewardTable.description: Adapter rewards on successful completion only.

assertions: default progress AND combo through actual keyboard/pointer hits
HP and deadline failures, no rewards
touch input and offline file launch

knownRisks: Browser input latency near timing boundaries; exact boundaries have unit coverage, not device latency calibration.
skipBoss:false legacy Boss mode remains available but is outside judged rhythm acceptance.
Arbitrary custom target/combo/duration combinations can be impossible; default preset is the tested playable configuration.
No physical-device FPS, multi-browser, musical audio synchronization or long soak certification.
implementationNotes: Judged rhythm uses a single frame-driven rules model within TapReactionAdapter. Perfect=10, Good=5; early/expired=miss once per beat and resets combo. Score alone cannot force host success. Uses runtime delta, not wall clock, and no tween callbacks grant rewards. Canonical knobs override legacy aliases. orbLifetimeMs and difficulty are legacy reaction-only.

maturityImpact.notes: Current judged timing implementation requires commit-bound Card Lab evidence; historical production labels are not retained as current certification.

exportPolicy.blockReason: Card Lab is synthetic browser acceptance, not full release certification.

residuals: full standalone export host E2E matrix
boss phase in production demos (skipBoss currently)
historicalCertification.note: Historical metadata only; not evidence for the judged timing runtime introduced in Card Lab.
